parsed.explanation: Part (i) of the refinement lemma is the write-up's only route to the universal upper bound (L3.2). Its proof rests on the column-sweep paragraph, where the two key quantitative claims — that each uncancelled array has at most s column-blocks and total length at most (T-d)/2 — are asserted, not derived. The parenthetical only gives that the two uncancelled totals sum to T-d; splitting a sum evenly requires equality of the two parts, which is nowhere shown, and the induction recurses on one array without bounding the other's odd-level contribution. No other passage proves the upper bound (the cited lemmas/refinement.md is outside the text). Repair needs a genuine lemma-level argument (e.g. subset-sum pigeonhole plus mirrored cuts).
